observations.body: Differing roles lead toward a more excellent way. God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages. But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 12:28–31 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states differing roles lead toward a more excellent way. God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages. But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
